ideas.pitch: An automated CLI tool that rapidly unpacks CTF challenge artifacts, parses obscure file formats, and scores the predictive utility of extracted tabular datasets in real-time.
ideas.title: CTF-Dataset-Scout
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the 4-hour time constraint by automating the bottleneck phase of the CTF challenge before ML modeling begins.

ideas.pitch: A robust data-cleaning pipeline designed specifically to automatically detect and discard malicious or intentionally bad decoy datasets uncovered during the CTF phase.
ideas.title: NoiseFilter-ML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the core twist of the DataHeist prompt where teams receive poisoned or useless datasets mixed in with valid ones.

ideas.pitch: A fast-executing automated machine learning wrapper built for 4-hour hackathons that instantly engineers features from mixed data sources and stacks robust predictive models.
ideas.title: RapidEnsemble-X
ideas.why_it_could_win: Maximizes predictive accuracy in a compressed timeframe, appealing directly to the judging criteria of building the strongest model quickly.

ideas.pitch: A centralized dashboard for teams to track discovered CTF clues, flag corrupted training variables, and visualize model performance metrics instantly.
ideas.title: DataHeist-Command-Center
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases a working live demo that keeps 1-3 member teams highly organized and efficient during a hyper-short 4-hour sprint.

ideas.pitch: An automated validation tool that explains feature importances and detects data leakage or severe bias in newly unlocked CTF datasets before they ruin the predictive model.
ideas.title: FeatureAuditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with advanced evaluation techniques seen in winning hackathon projects by ensuring model reliability and preventing overfitting on bad data.
